objectiveHistory: Get explicit human approval for the independent-verifier architecture before implementation begins

items.question: How does the verifier locate the correct SPEC.md to check against?
items.answer: Parent passes missionPath, verifier reads SPEC.md from there

items.question: How is the verifier agent instructed to perform verification?
items.answer: Dedicated verifier prompt. you can look at ~/fun/veda/veda-ts for an example

items.question: What is the exact structure of the verification report?
What specific action occurs when verifier finds issues?
items.answer: Return report to parent, parent decides to retry/accept/abort

items.question: What is the default value for the verify flag?

Do you approve the proposed boundaries: `spawn_agent` owns verify inputs + worker→verifier orchestration, `spawned-agents.ts` owns reminders/reporting, prompt files own contract text, and `~/.mu/agent/AGENTS.md` owns durable policy?
Do you approve the v1 abstractions: optional `verify`, optional `verificationChecks`, mission `SPEC.md` discovery from `missionPath`, and a simple verification report of `PASS|FAIL` plus issues?
Do you approve the v1 tradeoffs: same model as worker by default, sequential verification, read-only verifier, and parent decides retry/accept/abort after the report?
Do you approve these priorities: verifier independence, correctness + spec adherence, parent control, prompt/policy/runtime consistency, and mission-level verifier gates?

notes: Following up on spec discovery, prompt design, and exact failure handling

Recommended action: approve the v1 independent-verifier architecture so I can proceed to red tests. Why: the mission source of truth requires human approval before implementation, and the current proposal is already constrained to same-model, sequential worker→verifier flow with parent-controlled PASS/FAIL reporting.
